DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの欄についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which field on the notice is your question about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受取日という欄です。来週提出するので、来週の日付を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取日欄に予定提出日を書くか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The date received field. I will submit it next week, so should I write next week's date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to write the planned submission date in the date-received field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知を受け取った日と、回答を提出する日は別です。通知はいつ届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The day you received the notice and the day you submit your response are different. When did it arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日です。提出する日を書く欄だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知は昨日届き提出日欄と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday. I thought this field was for the submission date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it arrived yesterday and you mistook the field for submission date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 昨日届いたという情報を記録する欄か、担当に確認します。回答期限は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff member whether this field records that it arrived yesterday. Can you read the response deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月十五日とあります。受取日を書けば期限もその日から自動で延びるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記載期限を示し受取日で延長されるとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says the fifteenth of this month. I will not assume writing the received date automatically extends the deadline from that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the written deadline and that you do not assume the received date extends it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期限の扱いも通知の担当へ確認しましょう。回答の準備はできていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also check deadline handling with the notice's responsible staff. Is your response ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ必要な資料が一つありません。提出予定日を書くだけで間に合うことにせず、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足資料があり期限について相談したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am still missing one necessary document. I want to ask rather than treat writing a planned submission date as making it on time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say a document is missing and you want to discuss the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料について担当へ状況を伝えます。何が不足していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the staff member your document situation. What is missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務先の確認書です。受け取った日、不足している資料、提出できる見込みを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足資料と受取日と準備見込みを分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: A confirmation document from my workplace. I will explain the received date, missing document, and expected readiness separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the missing document, received date, and preparation outlook separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知と準備状況を見て、回答方法と期限について担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff member will review the notice and preparation status and explain the response method and deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腕の赤みを診てもらいたいです。肌のことなので、美容相談の列に並びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肌の症状で美容相談の列へ並んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want the redness on my arms examined. Since it concerns skin, I joined the cosmetic consultation line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you joined the cosmetic consultation line for skin symptoms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 美容の相談と、症状についての診療受付は分けて確認します。美容の施術をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will distinguish cosmetic advice from medical registration for symptoms. Are you seeking a cosmetic treatment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、施術の希望ではありません。赤みと痛みがあるので、診療を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 施術希望でなく赤みと痛みの診療を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I am not asking for a treatment. I have redness and pain and want a medical consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for medical care for redness and pain rather than a cosmetic treatment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状が出た時点と、使い始めたものがあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us when the symptoms appeared and whether you started using anything new.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤みに気付いたのは昨日です。新しいクリームを使いましたが、それが原因とはまだわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発症時点とクリーム使用を原因未確定の経過として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed the redness yesterday. I used a new cream, but I do not yet know whether it caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give symptom onset and cream use as a sequence with unconfirmed cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の症状についても診療担当へ伝えます。腕以外にもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also tell the clinical staff about your current symptoms. Are they anywhere besides your arms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今見えているのは両腕です。写真では片腕だけですが、実際の範囲は両腕だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片腕の写真と実際の両腕の症状範囲を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: What I can see now is on both arms. The photo shows only one arm, but I want to say the actual area is both arms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the photo of one arm from the actual symptoms on both arms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一般の診療受付へご案内します。クリームの情報もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will direct you to general medical reception. Do you also have information about the cream?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器の写真があります。肌の相談なら美容サービスを申し込むことだと考えず、症状と製品情報を診療担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器写真を示し美容申込でなく診療担当へ症状を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a photo of the container. I will not equate a skin inquiry with applying for cosmetic services; I will explain my symptoms and product information to clinical staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the container photo and explain symptoms to clinical staff, not as a cosmetic application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。施術の申し込みではなく、赤みと痛みの診療希望として受付へ引き継ぎます。こちらの案内窓口でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will pass this to reception as a request for medical care for redness and pain, not a cosmetic procedure. Please wait at this information counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵を拾われたのですね。どちらにありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found some keys, correct? Where were they?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道です。名札に住所らしい文字があるので、そこへ郵送しようかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道で拾い名札の住所らしい場所へ送ろうと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On the sidewalk. There is writing that looks like an address on the tag, so I thought of mailing them there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found them on the sidewalk and thought of sending them to an apparent address on the tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で送らず、こちらで確認します。文字の意味は確かめていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not send them yourself; we will check here. Have you confirmed what the writing means?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、住所なのか管理番号なのかわかりません。今も持ち主の家だとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字の意味も現在の持ち主住所かも不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I do not know whether it is an address or management number. I cannot say it is the current owner's home either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both the writing's meaning and whether it is the owner's current address are unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままお渡しください。鍵は何本ありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please hand them over as they are. How many keys were there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二本です。使える鍵か試しておらず、名札も外していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵二本を加工も試用もせず渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two. I have not tested whether they work or removed the tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over two keys without alteration or testing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us when you found them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正午ごろです。近くの建物の鍵穴に入れて確かめることもしませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾った時刻と建物で試していないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around noon. I also did not try them in the locks of nearby buildings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the finding time and say you have not tried them in buildings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。届けた方の情報を伺い、必要な手続きを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We will ask about you as the finder and explain the necessary procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。名札の文字をネットに載せて持ち主を探すこともせず、こちらに任せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名札をネットへ載せず届け出の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I also will not post the tag's writing online to find the owner; I would like to leave it to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not post the tag online; ask for reporting instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った状況と特徴を記録し、届け出の扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record the finding circumstances and features and explain how to make the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような転居のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What moving-related matter would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ建物の二階から三階へ移りました。建物が同じなら届け先も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ建物の階移動で届け先が変わるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved from the second to third floor of the same building. Does the delivery destination change even in the same building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether moving floors within the same building changes the delivery destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋番号が変わったのですね。以前と現在の住所表記を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your room number changed. Can we check the previous and current address wording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前は二〇一、今は三〇一です。建物名だけ同じなので、何もしなくてよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧二〇一と新三〇一を示して手続不要と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Previously 201, now 301. Only the building name is the same, so I thought I did not need to do anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give old 201 and new 301 and explain that you thought no procedure was needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便の扱いについて担当に確認しましょう。転居に関する手続きはされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check mail handling with the staff member. Have you completed any moving-related procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。以前の部屋に届いたと聞いたので、必要な手続きを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未手続で旧部屋への到着を聞いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I heard something arrived at the previous room, so I want to know the necessary procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say nothing has been done and you heard mail arrived at the old room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 以前の部屋には、現在どなたか住まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does anyone currently live in the old room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それは知りません。自分の部屋だったからといって、今の郵便受けを開けることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧部屋の現住人は不明で郵便受けを開けないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know. I will not open its mailbox just because it used to be my room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the current occupant is unknown and you will not open the mailbox. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。転居の手続きと、届いた郵便の確認方法を分けて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will explain moving procedures separately from how to check the delivered mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今後の差出人にも部屋番号を知らせますが、それだけで以前の郵便が動くとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人への変更連絡と既着郵便の対応を分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will also inform future senders of my room number, but will not assume that alone moves mail already delivered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask separately about informing senders of the change and handling already-delivered mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が必要な手続きを確認します。旧住所と新住所の部屋番号を正確に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will check necessary steps. Please give the old and new room numbers accurately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your registered address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、以前の住所はもう間違いなので、記録を全部消してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所を全部消して新住所にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, my previous address is wrong now, so please erase all the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want all the old address records erased and replaced with the new address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の住所の変更と、過去の記録の扱いは別です。以前はその住所にお住まいでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Changing your current address and handling past records are separate. Did you previously live at that address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、当時は正しい住所でした。最初から誤登録だったのではなく、今月引っ越しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所は当時正しく今月の転居だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it was correct then. It was not wrongly registered from the start; I moved this month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that the old address was accurate then and you moved this month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、転居による変更として確認します。新しい住所がわかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will check it as a change due to moving. Do you have documents showing the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。過去の履歴を消すことではなく、今後の連絡先を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去履歴ではなく今後の連絡先変更を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I want to correct my contact address going forward, not erase past history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to change future contact details rather than past history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が必要な資料と変更の範囲を確認します。発送済みの郵便についてお心当たりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check required documents and the scope of the change. Do you know of any mail already sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月の書類が発送されたかもしれません。住所を直せば発送済みの物も戻るとは思わず、別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送済み郵便の扱いを住所変更と別に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This month's documents may have been sent. I will not assume correcting the address recalls mailed items; I will ask separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss handling already-sent mail separately from address changes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送状況も担当へ確認します。電話番号も変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also check the shipping status with the staff member. Has your phone number changed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話番号は同じです。変わった住所と変わっていない番号を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所のみ変更で電話番号は同じと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is the same. I will distinguish the changed address from the unchanged number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say only the address changed and the phone number is the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。転居による住所変更と発送済み郵便の状況を、それぞれ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check the moving-related address change separately from the status of already-sent mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの表示についてお聞きになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which label would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この飲み物は小さい瓶なので、二人で飲むには足りないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小瓶の量で二人分足りるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This drink is in a small bottle. Would it be too little for two people?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the quantity in the small bottle is enough for two. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表には濃縮とあります。飲む前の作り方をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The front says concentrate. Have you read how to prepare it before drinking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見ていません。そのまま飲むものだと思って、瓶の量だけで比べていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 濃縮の作り方を読まずそのまま飲むと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I thought it was ready to drink and compared only the bottle volume.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not read the concentrate instructions and thought it was ready to drink. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示された割合で薄める商品か、説明を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check whether it is a product to dilute at the ratio shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。薄める前の量と、作った後の量を分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希釈前後の量を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to know the amount before dilution separately from the amount after preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the quantities before and after dilution separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらには作り方と一回分の目安があります。ご自宅で薄める準備はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the instructions and a serving guide. Can you prepare it for dilution at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 計量できる容器はありません。目分量で濃さを決めず、必要な道具も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 計量器具がなく目分量にせず道具を確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not have a measuring container. I do not want to guess the concentration by eye; I want to check the necessary utensils too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you lack measuring equipment and want to check utensils rather than estimate by eye. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのまま飲む別の商品もあります。用途はどちらが合いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are also other ready-to-drink products. Which better suits your purpose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はすぐ二人で飲みたいので、そのまま飲める商品と合計量を比較します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: すぐ飲む用途から希釈不要の商品と量を比較したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today, two of us want to drink it right away, so I will compare ready-to-drink products and their total amounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Based on immediate use, compare products requiring no dilution and their quantities. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。作り方と今回の用途を確認し、瓶の大きさだけで選ばないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check preparation and today's purpose so you do not choose by bottle size alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩する場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、あの運動区画が空いているので、中で少し休んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空いている運動区画内で休めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, that sports area is empty. May I rest inside for a little while?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can rest in an empty sports area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空いて見えても予約や利用条件がある場合があります。区画の案内はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if it looks empty, there may be reservations or use conditions. Have you read the area's information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。誰もいなければ、散歩道と同じように使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人がいなければ散歩道同様に使えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought if nobody was there, it could be used like a walking path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought an unoccupied area could be used like a walking path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内と利用状況を担当に確認しましょう。運動の利用をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the instructions and availability with the staff member. Do you want to use it for exercise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、休むだけです。区画を予約するより、散歩の人が使えるベンチを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運動ではなく一般利用のベンチを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, just resting. Rather than book the area, I want to know a bench available to people walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a bench for general use rather than exercise. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 区画の外の休憩場所を確認します。何人で休まれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check a rest area outside the section. How many people will rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人です。通路に荷物を置いて席を作ることはせず、座れる場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人で通路へ荷物を広げず座りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two. We only need somewhere to sit; we will not spread luggage on the path to make seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say two people want to sit without spreading belongings on the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 区画の外にある二人で座れるベンチはこちらです。運動区画を通り抜けたい予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is a bench outside the area where two people can sit. Do you plan to pass through the sports area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。区画の中を近道にせず、案内された散歩道からベンチへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区画を近道にせず案内された道を使うと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. I will not use it as a shortcut; I will follow the walking path you showed to the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use the guided path rather than cut through the area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの散歩道からベンチへお進みください。予約区画に入らず、二人で休める場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take this walking path to the bench. It is somewhere two people can rest without entering the reserved area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの出口へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which exit are you heading for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五番出口です。五号車に乗れば、近くで降りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口と同じ番号の車両が近いか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Exit five. If I board car five, can I get off nearby?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the car with the same number as the exit is close. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出口番号と車両番号は対応しているとは限りません。到着駅はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Exit numbers and car numbers do not necessarily correspond. Which station are you arriving at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅です。同じ五だから近いと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着駅を示し番号対応を思い込んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This station. I thought they were close because both were five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the arrival station and explain your assumption that the numbers corresponded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着する乗り場から出口への経路を確認しましょう。歩く距離を短くしたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the route from the arrival platform to the exit. Do you want to shorten your walking distance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、重い荷物があります。階段の少なさも含めて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物が重く歩行距離と階段を少なくしたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I have heavy luggage. I also want to choose with fewer stairs in mind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your luggage is heavy and you want less walking and fewer stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口までの道と設備を確認します。目的地は五番出口のすぐ近くですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the path and facilities to the exit. Is your destination right near exit five?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、宿泊先の案内に五番とあります。別の出口からも行けるか宿に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿の指定出口以外から行けるか確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, my accommodation's instructions say five. I would like to ask them whether another exit can be used too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to check whether the accommodation is accessible from a different exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口を決めてから、その出口へ向かいやすい車両を係員に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After deciding the exit, you can ask staff which car makes reaching it easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。番号だけで五号車に決めず、宿への道と駅内の道を合わせて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅内と宿への経路を合わせて車両を選ぶ方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not choose car five just by the number; I will consider the route inside the station together with the route to my accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State a plan to choose the car considering both station and accommodation routes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で確認しましょう。今の乗り場と到着駅の案内をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check in that order. We will show information for your current platform and arrival station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。前の住所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a moving-in inquiry, correct? We will check your former address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 町名は前も今も本町なので、同じ市内の引っ越しだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ町名で市内転居と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The neighborhood name is Honcho both before and now, so I thought it was a move within the same city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the same neighborhood name made you assume an in-city move. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 町名だけでなく市区町村名も確認しましょう。住所の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the municipality name too, not only the neighborhood. Do you have address documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、前の書類と新しい契約の住所です。市の名前は違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前後の書類を示して市名の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, my previous document and the address in the new contract. The city names differ, don't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show before-and-after documents and confirm the different city names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手続きの種類を担当が確認します。すでに何か申請されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the procedure type. Have you already submitted anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。町名が同じだからと市内の変更用紙を使わず、必要な手続きを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未申請で適切な用紙と手続きを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I do not want to use an in-city change form just because the neighborhood names match; I want to ask what procedure is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not applied and ask for the appropriate form and procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際に引っ越した日も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell us when you actually moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一昨日です。契約を結んだのは先月ですが、住み始めたのは一昨日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約日と実際の転居日を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The day before yesterday. I signed the contract last month, but started living there the day before yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the contract date from the actual moving date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に住所全体と日付を伝えます。ご家族も一緒に移られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will give the full addresses and dates to the staff member. Did your family move with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は私だけです。前の家に残る家族を転入する人に含めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分のみ移り残る家族は対象外と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only me this time. Please do not include family staying in the old home among those moving in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say only you moved and family remaining are not included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。町名、市名、転居日、対象者を分けて確認し、担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check neighborhood, city, moving date, and persons covered separately and direct you to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更したい予約はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which appointment do you want to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜日の診察です。画面に木曜日の空きがあるので、そこへ移したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 元予約と画面の別曜日の空き枠を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Friday's consultation. The screen shows an opening on Thursday, so I want to move there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the original appointment and another day's opening on the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木曜日の枠は同じ担当の診療ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is Thursday's slot with the same doctor?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく見ると医師の名前が違います。時間だけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 医師名が違い時刻だけ見ていたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking closely, the doctor's name differs. I was looking only at the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that the doctor differs and you looked only at the time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診療内容や担当の扱いを確認する必要があります。日時だけの変更を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the consultation type and assignment. Do you only want a date and time change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、同じ相談を続けたいです。別の医師で同じように受けられるかは自分では決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ相談を継続したく別担当の適否は未判断と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I want to continue the same consultation. I cannot decide myself whether the same care can be provided by another doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to continue the same consultation and have not judged another doctor's suitability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。金曜日の何時が難しいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check with the staff member. What time on Friday is difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前が仕事と重なります。金曜日の午後か、同じ担当の別日なら相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 難しい時間帯と同じ担当での代替候補を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The morning conflicts with work. Friday afternoon or another day with the same doctor could work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the difficult period and alternatives with the same doctor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補を伝えます。現在の予約はまだ残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will pass on those options. Is your current booking still in place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。別枠を新しく取って二つにせず、変更方法の説明を待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元予約を残し重複予約せず変更案内を待つと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have not made a separate booking that would leave two; I am waiting for instructions about changing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the old booking and wait for change instructions without duplicate booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。同じ診療を継続する希望と候補日時を、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check your wish to continue the same care and possible dates with the staff member.
